commits.message:
Update NNUE architecture to SFNNv18 and net nn-c9e480e92425.nnue

Introduce the SFNNv18 NNUE architecture:
- Replace HalfKAv2_hm with K32Q2 feature set, conditioning on own king position (32 buckets) and opponent queen presence (2 states).
- Expand layer stacks from 8 to 32, indexed by piece count and queen bucket (pc_bucket * 4 + queen_bucket).
- Quantize feature transformer weights to int8 and simplify parameter serialization to uncompressed little-endian format, removing LEB128 routines.
- Update accumulator management and Finny table caches to track opponent queen presence, requiring accumulator refresh on king moves and opponent queen captures or promotions.
- Update default net to nn-c9e480e92425.nnue.

Improve matefinding

When seeking a mate, focus the search on forcing lines, with three search modifications that are guarded by the seekmate condition. On the matetrack suite this finds 4065 mates vs 3898 for master (+167), Measured in isolation the three terms contribute:
contribute +71 (null move reduction), +44 (small ProbCut) and +39 (LMR). A forth term tested in SPRT was dropped as there was no real gain on current master.

As done previously SPRT test vs a control build with seekMate disabled, to guarantee no drift in performance in game play.

commits.author: Carlos Esparza <ca2010es@gmail.com>
commits.message:
Only generate legal moves in movegen

The main changes here are by @rhirsch123. I have added some speedups and identified some more code that can be removed if we only ever deal with legal moves.
The only(?) important implementation detail of legal move generation is that we now keep a bitboard of squares threatened by `~sideToMove` in `Position`, to help with king move generation. For speed and conciseness, we include x-ray threats through the `sideToMove`-colored king (this only matters when `sideToMove` is in check). As a bonus, these bitboards get re-used in quiet move scoring.

Things that can be simplified once we have legal movegen:
- We can merge the `legal()` and `pseudo_legal()` methods
- Since we have threat bitboards, we no longer need `attackers_to_exist()` in `legal()`, so we can remove that method
- We don't need a separate `generate<LEGAL>` method that performs legality checks
- This also means the `NON_EVASIONS` movegen target becomes redundant

The change to `ray_pass_bb()` is outdated but should still be beneficial for performance.

commits.author: Kars <karstenwscholten@gmail.com>
commits.message:
Remove three always-true conditions in search

removes three conditions in search.cpp that can no longer be false:

step 6, Case B: this branch is only reached when the TT entry was deep enough but Case A did not apply. That means the bound is the opposite one-sided bound, so `ttData.bound != BOUND_EXACT` and the bound-direction check always hold. Only `depth > 5` needed

the branch before capture countermove bonus already handles `!priorCapture && prevSq != SQ_NONE`, so `priorCapture` is always true here.
qsearch stand pat: `bestValue` is either the clamped static eval or a TT value that already passed `!is_decisive`, so it can never be decisive at this point (since b0870cf5).
